units.source_text: 封好之后，又茫然地沉思了一会。

en.t: After sealing it, he sat for a while longer in blank, bewildered thought.

units.source_text: 他近来神情一直恍惚，自己也常常觉得过分伤心。

en.t: Lately his expression had remained dazed, and he himself often felt that his grief had gone too far.

units.source_text: 为欲排遣，便常住在侍女们的室中。

en.t: To distract himself, he often stayed in the rooms of the ladies-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 又命佛堂里少住些人，以便专心念经。

en.t: He also ordered fewer people to stay in the chapel, so that he could devote himself to chanting sutras.

units.source_text: 他和紫夫人实指望共守千年，

en.t: He and Lady Murasaki had truly hoped to remain together for a thousand years,

units.source_text: 无奈人命有限，终成永诀，真乃抱恨无穷。

en.t: but human life has its limits, and in the end they were parted forever, leaving him with endless regret.

units.source_text: 现在他渴望死后共生同一莲座之上，

en.t: Now he longed for them to be reborn after death together upon the same lotus seat,

units.source_text: 他事一切不顾，只管虔修往生成佛之道。

en.t: and, disregarding everything else, he devoted himself solely to the path of rebirth and Buddhahood.

units.source_text: 然而又恐外人非笑，实甚可厌。

en.t: Yet he also feared that outsiders would mock him, which was deeply distasteful to him.

units.source_text: 紫夫人丧期中应有佛事，源氏都无力指示，一切均由夕雾大将办理。

en.t: For the Buddhist rites required during Lady Murasaki's mourning period, Genji had no strength to give directions, so General Yugiri handled everything.

units.source_text: 源氏一心希望早日遁世，只管“今天，明天”地计算。

en.t: Genji wished only to leave the world as soon as possible, and kept counting the days, thinking, today, tomorrow.

units.source_text: 胡乱度送岁月，但觉身在梦中。

en.t: He passed the days aimlessly, feeling only as though he were living in a dream.

units.source_text: 明石皇后等人也思念紫夫人，无时或忘，恋慕不已。

en.t: The Akashi Empress and the others also thought of Lady Murasaki constantly, never forgetting her and longing for her without end.
